metadata.title: Gamedev Godot - Sources
metadata.description: Primary sources for creating a Godot 4.x game from empty project to exported build with mid-2026 best practices: editor/project setup, typed GDScript and C#, scene/node architecture, signals and autoloads, CharacterBody movement, TileMapLayer/GridMap, profiling and object pooling, renderer choice, and per-platform export. Godot facts drift across 4.x minor versions; volatile sources are marked add_as_web_search for live re-verification.

setup_and_project.name: Godot Docs - Introduction & Getting Started
setup_and_project.description: Official getting-started path: editor tour, first project, scenes and nodes. Version-pinned to /stable/; check the version selector for your minor.

setup_and_project.name: Godot Docs - Project Organization & Best Practices
setup_and_project.description: Official guidance on folder layout, version control, and what to commit vs gitignore.

setup_and_project.name: Godot Docs - Version Control Systems
setup_and_project.description: Official gitignore recommendations, including excluding the generated .godot/ cache.

setup_and_project.name: Godot Docs - InputEvent & Input Map
setup_and_project.description: Official input handling: input map actions, Input singleton, get_vector for movement.

language_and_architecture.name: Godot Docs - GDScript Reference
language_and_architecture.description: Official GDScript language reference: static typing, class_name, @export, @onready.

language_and_architecture.name: Godot Docs - Signals
language_and_architecture.description: Official signals tutorial underpinning the signals-up / calls-down decoupling pattern.

language_and_architecture.name: Godot Docs - Singletons (Autoload)
language_and_architecture.description: Official autoload/singleton guidance for cross-scene global state.

language_and_architecture.name: Godot Docs - Idle & Physics Processing
language_and_architecture.description: Official explanation of _process vs _physics_process and the fixed timestep.

language_and_architecture.name: Godot Docs - C# / .NET Basics
language_and_architecture.description: Official C# support docs including platform/export caveats. Web export support for C# is volatile across 4.x - verify.

scenes_nodes_and_performance.name: Godot Docs - Nodes and Scenes
scenes_nodes_and_performance.description: Official model of scenes as reusable prefabs and the node tree.

scenes_nodes_and_performance.name: Godot Docs - CharacterBody2D / move_and_slide
scenes_nodes_and_performance.description: Official CharacterBody movement pattern: set velocity, call move_and_slide().

scenes_nodes_and_performance.name: Godot Docs - Using TileMapLayer
scenes_nodes_and_performance.description: Official 2D tile workflow. The monolithic TileMap node was split into TileMapLayer in a 4.x minor - verify the current node for your version.

scenes_nodes_and_performance.name: Godot Docs - The Profiler & Optimization
scenes_nodes_and_performance.description: Official profiler and debugging tools for finding real bottlenecks before optimizing.

rendering_and_export.name: Godot Docs - Renderers
rendering_and_export.description: Official Forward+ / Mobile / Compatibility renderer comparison and target guidance. Names/capabilities drift across 4.x - verify.

rendering_and_export.name: Godot Docs - Exporting Projects & Export Templates
rendering_and_export.description: Official export workflow, export-template version matching, per-platform presets, and headless CI export.

rendering_and_export.name: Godot Docs - Global Illumination (LightmapGI / SDFGI / VoxelGI)
rendering_and_export.description: Official GI comparison: baked LightmapGI vs real-time SDFGI (Forward+ only) vs VoxelGI, and renderer constraints.

rendering_and_export.name: Godot Docs - Pipeline Compilations / Shader Stutter
rendering_and_export.description: Official guidance on shader/pipeline compilation stutter and mitigation (cache, pre-warm). Path/naming drifts across versions - verify.

rendering_and_export.name: Godot Docs - High-level Multiplayer
rendering_and_export.description: Official MultiplayerAPI, MultiplayerSynchronizer, and @rpc annotations for server-authoritative networking.

rendering_and_export.name: Godot Docs - Saving Games (FileAccess / ResourceSaver security)
rendering_and_export.description: Official save-system guidance; JSON via FileAccess vs custom Resources, and the resource-deserialization security caveat.

rendering_and_export.name: Godot Engine Blog - Introducing the Godot Asset Store
rendering_and_export.description: Official announcement of the Asset Store replacing the Asset Library starting in 4.7; old Asset Library links break. Re-verify migration status per release.

rendering_and_export.name: Godot Engine - Console Support
rendering_and_export.description: Official statement that Godot has no first-party console export; console shipping requires a third-party middleware/porting vendor. Verify current vendor list before committing to a console SKU.
